objective: Test whether a GPU-trained meta-model can predict which v5 entries win, from point-in-time features, well enough to improve v5 by trading only the top-ranked entries -- and whether the filtered book survives the canonical gate.

honest_framing.labels_are_modeled: Labels are the BS-MODELED v5 PnL (no OPRA real options yet), so this tests 'are v5's winners predictable from features', an upper bound to confirm with real options once OPRA is signed.
honest_framing.small_n: 1044 trades, 81% base win rate -- the task is spotting the ~19% losers. Small n; expect the gate to still bite (the documented per-trade-Sharpe deflation wall). GPU is used as specified but is NOT the bottleneck at this scale; it earns its keep only at intraday x real-option scale.
honest_framing.not_a_v5_retune: This is a NEW hypothesis (a meta-filter on v5), not a parameter change to v5. v5 stays the champion base.

label: win = pnl_usd > 0 (meta-label, Lopez de Prado)
model: XGBoost, tree_method=hist, device=cuda, float32, QuantileDMatrix; expanding walk-forward by date (macro_gpu_lab walk_forward_splits), refit per fold, purged by the trade horizon.
use: Trade only entries in the model's top decile of predicted win-prob per fold -> filtered v5. Report the filtered book's cluster-adjusted PnL + canonical gate.

trial_accounting.n_trials_note: The meta-model's search (the single pre-registered config here) adds to the deflation; report DSR with n_trials counting this experiment. No hyperparameter sweep -- one fixed config. A sweep would be a separate prereg counting every combo.
trial_accounting.no_threshold_softening: PBO<0.5 AND DSR>0 fixed. Higher win rate on a filtered subset does not override a failed DSR or a smaller-n deflation penalty.

falsifiable_predictions: top-decile filtered win rate > the 81% base
filtered per-trade mean PnL > unfiltered v5
the meta-model's out-of-sample rank-IC (pred win-prob vs realized win) is > 0
promotion: No promotion. Informs whether an ML meta-filter is worth building on real-option labels once OPRA is available. SHADOW throughout.
